claim: Message match is the continuity between an ad's promise and the landing page the click reaches; breaks in match destroy paid-traffic conversion.
definition: Message match (also called landing-page congruence in the post-click sense) is the degree to which the landing experience continues the ad's offer, audience, and creative promise rather than introducing a different story.
caveats: Message match is necessary but not sufficient; routing and holdouts measure whether variants actually lift.
